issues.issue: Is the cousin's written testimony (obtained after the RPD hearing) admissible under IRPA s.110(4)?
issues.applicant_position: Cousin's testimony was obtained after the RPD hearing, relates to the appellant and shows ongoing threats.
issues.result_text: Testimony mainly confirms facts before rejection already found not credible; inadmissible on appeal.

issues.issue: Should an oral hearing be held?
issues.applicant_position: Cousin's testimony corroborates persecution by in-laws over the forced marriage refusal; requests an oral hearing.
issues.result_text: Submitted evidence is inadmissible, so holding an oral hearing is not possible.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in its credibility findings on the threats and break-in?
issues.applicant_position: RPD's credibility findings on in-laws' threats and the break-in are inconsistent and unfair.
issues.result_text: RAD's own analysis finds no RPD errors; contradictions, omissions and vagueness undermine the claim.
